question: I love all of the Re:Zero anime key visuals because they're so appealing. Are there any key visuals that you particularly like?
answer:
The wide, full-cast one from Season 3. The one with the Sin Archbishops on the right, almost like they're comrades (laughs), and all the Royal Selection candidates and Subaru's group lined up on the left.

That one really got me excited! I was also really happy that they drew so many characters. On top of that, I really like how the characters are positioned so that their matchups line up with each other.

(Season 3 Key Visual 2)
